blocks.text: THE ENCIRCLEMENT OF ISRAEL PROPHESIED!— ‘‘Not only is Israel surrounded by armies on every side, but she is being circled by several world navies! One of them the United States which is friendly to her and the other the sinister Russian Navy by way of the Persian Gulf and the Arabian Sea! Its warships speed up and down the Red Sea! They come down from the Black Sea!’’ — ‘‘So Israel is now confronted on all sides! — The world is preparing for Ezek. chap. 38 with ultra modern weapons!’’ — ‘‘ABC News could describe it no better when they said, the next world war will be fought on the electronic battle field (atomic push button) fulfilling this Scripture! — I Thess. 5:3, ‘‘When it looks safe, sudden destruction shall come upon them.’’ . . . ‘‘Almost 2000 yrs. ago the Bible predicted the exact circumstances and it would occur just before the Translation!’ — St. Luke 21:20, ‘‘When ye shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies, know that desolation is nigh!” . . . ““We can expect some more climactic developments and dramatic events to occur in the 1980's.

IN THE NEWS— The GREAT SYNAGOGUE -— ‘“‘is supposed to be completed by 1982! If it is not the Jewish Temple spoken of in Rev. 11:1-2 - II Thess. 2:4, then the real one will be built swiftly and very soon!’’ — ‘‘A false messiah will rise and evidently will restore the old Abrahamic covenant! (Dan. 9:27) When he confirms the land to them and makes a truce and provides protection, they receive him as messiah! But after 3% years he will break his agreement! Evidently the Common Market countries and the United States will be involved! The Bible calls it, the covenant with death!”’ (Isa. 28:18) — ‘Some believe this Scripture referring to the Tabernacle of David has to do with the Jewish Temple — Acts 15:15-16. But this could involve the millennium Temple!’’ — ‘‘The 1980’s will bring all of this into focus better! — All prophetic signs indicate that this 20th Century will close out the age!’’ — ‘‘Even well known statesmen and scientists are beginning to say that this present civilization cannot survive beyond the year 2000! And the intensity of the judgment and rebellion will be so great that Jesus must shorten the time! (Matt. 24:22)

EXTREME AND ERRATIC WEATHER CHANGES TO AP- PEAR IN THE 80’s— ‘‘Evidently we will see a good amount of this between 1981-84. — Somewhere in the later 80’s and before the early 90’s we should watch for world food shortages!’’ — ‘‘Also according to Scriptural signs it will not be too long before the pale horse rides, and 4 of the world population will be cut off by starvation!”’ (Rev. 6:8) — “‘According to Rev. 9:18 involving the apocalyptic judgments another third will be swept away! — It will be safe to say that out of the 5 or 6 billion people on earth at that time, that there will be few left! — See (Isa. 24:6) — “It mentions the earth is burned! Partly by atomic holocaust and God’s plagues!’’. .. “‘And many definite signs point to the fact that all this could take place before the year 2000!”’ . . . “The Bible says, ‘‘Behold, I come quickly!’’ — Amen! And in an hour that ye think not! — ‘‘Also according to Bible chronology we will complete 6,000 years of man’s week in not too many years hence!’’

ECONOMIC CONDITIONS— ‘‘The United States will also go through some more financial ups and downs in the 80’s!”’ . . . And then will return again to prosperity! You can check other scrolls and letters for more information . . . revealing it leads to a new world order, developing into the deadly anti-christ!”’ . . . ‘I might add right here by prophetic gift, I foresee a world revolution coming in the 80’s! — Plus the United States is headed for severe and extreme problems during the next four years! — One should prepare his heart diligently to serve the Lord now!”’

HEADING INTO THE TRIBULATION— ‘‘We will have more volcanic eruptions! — This was predicted in my earlier writings and is occurring! . . . Also they could have another severe volcanic eruption around Ore. and Wash. along the ring of fire zone as it is called!”’ . . . ‘During the 80’s we will see some worldwide earthquakes! We should watch the years 1982 and ’83.’’ — ‘‘California is also getting ready for a catastrophic quake! . . . And before the ending of the 80’s people will probably see earthquakes in scope in all parts of the world in gigantic shakings!’’
Note — “‘The Reagan prophecy given in our letters over a decade ago has been fulfilled! Will elaborate more later!’’

PROPHETIC UPDATE ON IMMORALS— “‘According to the Scriptures in different parts of the Old Testament people had live sex right in the sanctuary of their Temple involving idols too! (I Sam. 2:22 - Ezek. 23:17-20, 39 - Ezek. 8:12-16) And I predicted that it would occur in this modern age! One night in a vision years ago I saw the moral plight of the whole world and some day will describe it all!’? — ‘‘The latest concerning my prediction occurred in a church in Seattle, Wash. according to the news report. They have actual live sex.acts performed before the audience! They have ordered the people of the Temple of Venus to court to try to prevent this from occurring! They are supposed to have a trial!’” — ‘‘More such occurrences will occur during the Great Tribulation involving idols!’’ — ‘‘This Scripture evidently repeats again Ezek. 16:20-21, 28, 33-36!”’

LIFE SIZE DOLLS AND ELECTRONIC SEX— ‘‘Here is another prediction written years ago that is occurring! They now have beautiful dolls for men to order or buy, and also women can buy male dolls for themselves too, they can be inflated and are made out of rubber like skin! They have cassettes made inside that talk lustfully to them, can wink, etc.’’ — ‘‘The girl form can pulsate and vibrate with the touch of a button, and so does the male form! And I don’t have to tell you what areas that it is that vibrate!’’? — ‘‘In their imagination these actually become, to them, their sexual partners!”’ . . . “They are complete in all that is involved with the human form!”’ . .. ‘And the promotional come-on in the ads say to the women, and you don’t have to worry about him getting tired, etc. Rom. 1:30 ‘‘inventions of pleasure’’ . . . ‘‘The world is in the age of sexual revolutionary fantasy surpassing ancient Rome! — We don’t necessarily like to write about these things, but it proves prophecy and Jesus’ statements concerning immoral conditions as the age ends!’’ — ‘‘We could write many more things, but this proves time is short!’’

THE SPERM BANK AND THE SUPER KIDS!— “There is talk now for a sperm bank for the Nobel winners to bring forth more genius!’’ — ‘‘Professing themselves to be wise they became fools!’’ (Rom. 1:22,25) — ‘‘Already we have witnessed the test tube baby . . where the sperm and egg were united in a test tube and then implanted in a mother’s womb!’ — ‘‘Plans are already underway in a New York sperm bank to have a genetic supermarket! — You go to the sperm bank, tell them the type of child you would like, listing such preferences as: color of hair . . . color of eyes . . . short or tall, or medium height . . . race . . . IQ (intelligence level) . . . passive or aggressive type . . . career-oriented to medicine, engineering, etc.”’. . . “Your desires are run through a computer which aligns your specifications with available sperm tubes in the bank! With that match, the wife is implanted with the sperm and conception occurs! . . . This was predicted in 1967’? — (see latter paragraph of Scr. #7, part 1) (perfect fulfillment!) . . . ‘Also this is just one little aspect of what humanism points to! — And is associated to religious humanism and the Laodicean Church! (Rev. 3: 14-17) (and Rev. chap. 13) . . . (a) ‘‘Humanism denies the deity of the Lord Jesus Christ! . . . (b) Denies the Bible and the existence of the soul! . . . (c) Denies salvation, heaven and hell!’’ . . . (d) ‘‘Believes there are no absolutes, no right, no wrong! . . . (e) That moral values are self determined and that you can do whatever you want!’’.. . (f) ‘‘Wants the removal of distinctive roles of male and female!”’ . . . (g) “The promotion of all the sins of Sodom and much more!’ . . . (1) “Believes in sexual freedom regardless of age!”’ . . . (2) ‘‘Believes in abortion!”’ . . . (3) ‘‘Also in mercy killing and suicide!’ . . . (4) “Believes in equal distribution of wealth to bring about equality.” — (same as Communism) . . . (5) ‘‘Wants the removal of American patriotism and the free enterprise system!’’ . . . (6) ‘‘Disarmanent”’ (Rev. 6:2) . . . (7) And the creation of a one world, socialist government!’’ — ‘‘What is this joined to? Read Rev. chap. 13, the beast is appearing! Strong delusion is forerunning his rise!’’ (II Thess. 2: 9-12) . . . ‘The hour is late, let us pray for a harvest of souls!’’
